buildCommand:
node ../scripts/build-library.mjs > build-output.txt 2>&1; b=$?; node --test ../scripts/validation/validation.test.mjs > validation-test-output.txt 2>&1; t=$?; node ../scripts/validate-content.mjs > validation-content-output.txt 2>&1; v=$?; printf 'build=%s
tests=%s
content=%s
' "$b" "$t" "$v" > validation-results.txt; exit 0
